findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?tools=all" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, page_to_markdown, seo_check, page_check, find_data, extract_strings, read_barcode, company_facts · Private data: har_to_openapi, inspect_binary, extract_strings, inspect_apk, read_barcode, company_facts, json_formatter · Public sink: yard_drainage_cause, funeral_cost, pickleball_court_cost, ev_charger_install_cost, extract_strings, company_facts · Destructive: furnace_age, wheelchair_ramp, inspect_binary, read_barcode, make_run_loop, apa_citation_generator, json_formatter.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, page_to_markdown, seo_check, page_check, find_data, extract_strings, read_barcode, company_facts · Private data: har_to_openapi, inspect_binary, extract_strings, inspect_apk, read_barcode, company_facts, json_formatter · Public sink: yard_drainage_cause, funeral_cost, pickleball_court_cost, ev_charger_install_cost, extract_strings, company_facts · Destructive: furnace_age, wheelchair_ramp, inspect_binary, read_barcode, make_run_loop, apa_citation_generator, json_formatter

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
